cases.name: an authorized offline SIP+RTP capture yields exact flows, media, metering and routes

argv:
sub pkt { my($s,$d,$sp,$dp,$pl)=@_; my $udp=pack("nnnn",$sp,$dp,8+length($pl),0).$pl; my $ip=pack("CCnnnCCnNN",0x45,0,20+length($udp),1,0,64,17,0,$s,$d).$udp; my $eth=("\x00\x11\x22\x33\x44\x55"x1)."\x66\x77\x88\x99\xaa\xbb".pack("n",0x0800).$ip; return $eth; } my $g=pack("VvvlVVV",0xa1b2c3d4,2,4,0,0,65535,1); my $out=$g; my $t=1700000000; my $sip="INVITE sip:bob\@example.test SIP/2.0
Via: SIP/2.0/UDP 10.0.0.1:5060
Call-ID: abc
CSeq: 1 INVITE
Content-Length: 0

"; my @p=(pkt(0x0a000001,0x0a000002,5060,5060,$sip)); for my $i (0..19){ my $rtp=pack("CCnNN",0x80,0,$i,$i*160,0x1234).("\xff"x160); push @p,pkt(0x0a000001,0x0a000002,16384,16386,$rtp); } my $i=0; for my $p (@p){ $out.=pack("VVVV",$t,$i*20000,length($p),length($p)).$p; $i++; } print $out;

W="$1"; C=$("$W" ingest-pcap c.pcap --authorized --root wr | sed 's/.*"capture_id":"\([0-9a-f]*\)".*/\1/'); "$W" flows "$C" --root wr; "$W" media-detect "$C" --root wr; "$W" meter "$C" --root wr; "$W" route "$C" --root wr
